local function emit(...)
    local words = {...}
    for i = 1, #words do
        words[i] = tostring(words[i])
    end
    io.write(table.concat(words, " "), "\n")
end

local function fail(message)
    error({command_error = true, message = message}, 0)
end
local function input_line()
    return (io.read("l"):gsub("\r$", ""))
end
local function split(line)
    local words = {}
    for word in line:gmatch("%S+") do
        words[#words + 1] = word
    end
    return words
end
local function fill(size, value)
    local values = {}
    for i = 1, size do
        values[i] = value
    end
    return values
end
local function copy_list(values)
    local result = {}
    for i = 1, #values do
        result[i] = values[i]
    end
    return result
end
local function count_true(values)
    local count = 0
    for _, value in pairs(values) do
        if value then
            count = count + 1
        end
    end
    return count
end
local function fraction(numerator, denominator)
    local a, b = numerator, denominator
    while b ~= 0 do
        a, b = b, a % b
    end
    return (numerator // a) .. "/" .. (denominator // a)
end
local function totals()
    return {rounds = 0, flagged = 0, opened = 0, guesses = 0}
end
local function add_totals(total, other)
    total.rounds = total.rounds + other.rounds
    total.flagged = total.flagged + other.flagged
    total.opened = total.opened + other.opened
end
local function any_deduction(result)
    return next(result.safe) ~= nil or next(result.mines) ~= nil
end

local Component = {}
Component.__index = Component
function Component.new(cells, constraints)
    return setmetatable(
        {
            cells = cells,
            constraints = constraints,
            configurations = 0,
            minimum = #cells,
            maximum = 0,
            mine_counts = fill(#cells, 0),
            counted = false
        },
        Component
    )
end
function Component:search(depth, mines)
    if depth > #self.cells then
        self.configurations = self.configurations + 1
        self.minimum, self.maximum = math.min(self.minimum, mines), math.max(self.maximum, mines)
        for i, value in ipairs(self.assignment) do
            self.mine_counts[i] = self.mine_counts[i] + value
        end
        return
    end
    local variable = self.order[depth]
    for value = 0, 1 do
        self.assignment[variable] = value
        local possible = true
        for _, c in ipairs(self.links[variable]) do
            self.remaining[c] = self.remaining[c] - 1
            self.sums[c] = self.sums[c] + value
            local required = self.constraints[c].remaining
            if self.sums[c] > required or self.sums[c] + self.remaining[c] < required then
                possible = false
            end
        end
        if possible then
            self:search(depth + 1, mines + value)
        end
        for _, c in ipairs(self.links[variable]) do
            self.sums[c], self.remaining[c] = self.sums[c] - value, self.remaining[c] + 1
        end
    end
end
function Component:count()
    if self.counted then
        return
    end
    self.counted = true
    for _, c in ipairs(self.constraints) do
        if c.remaining < 0 or c.remaining > #c.unknown then
            return
        end
    end
    self.index, self.links, self.order, self.remaining = {}, {}, {}, {}
    for i, cell in ipairs(self.cells) do
        self.index[cell], self.links[i], self.order[i] = i, {}, i
    end
    for c, constraint in ipairs(self.constraints) do
        self.remaining[c] = #constraint.unknown
        for _, cell in ipairs(constraint.unknown) do
            local links = self.links[self.index[cell]]
            links[#links + 1] = c
        end
    end
    table.sort(
        self.order,
        function(a, b)
            if #self.links[a] ~= #self.links[b] then
                return #self.links[a] > #self.links[b]
            end
            return a < b
        end
    )
    self.sums, self.assignment = fill(#self.constraints, 0), fill(#self.cells, 0)
    self:search(1, 0)
end
function Component:mine_count(cell)
    return self.mine_counts[self.index[cell]]
end

local Game = {}
Game.__index = Game
function Game.new(width, height, mine_count, seed, placement)
    local size = width * height
    local self =
        setmetatable(
        {
            width = width,
            height = height,
            size = size,
            mine_count = mine_count,
            seed = seed,
            numbers = fill(size, 0),
            neighbors = {},
            revealed = fill(size, false),
            marks = fill(size, "none"),
            state = "ready",
            moves = {},
            undo = {}
        },
        Game
    )
    for cell = 1, size do
        local x, y = (cell - 1) % width, (cell - 1) // width
        local nearby = {}
        for dy = -1, 1 do
            for dx = -1, 1 do
                if
                    (dx ~= 0 or dy ~= 0) and x + dx >= 0 and x + dx < width and y + dy >= 0 and
                        y + dy < height
                 then
                    nearby[#nearby + 1] = (y + dy) * width + x + dx + 1
                end
            end
        end
        self.neighbors[cell] = nearby
    end
    if placement then
        self:set_placement(placement)
    end
    return self
end
function Game:finished()
    return self.state == "won" or self.state == "lost"
end
function Game:cell(cell)
    return ((cell - 1) % self.width) .. "," .. ((cell - 1) // self.width)
end
function Game:unknown(cell)
    return not self.revealed[cell] and self.marks[cell] ~= "flag"
end
function Game:remaining()
    local flags = 0
    for _, mark in ipairs(self.marks) do
        if mark == "flag" then
            flags = flags + 1
        end
    end
    return self.mine_count - flags
end
function Game:open_count()
    return count_true(self.revealed)
end
function Game:flags(cell)
    local flags = 0
    for _, other in ipairs(self.neighbors[cell]) do
        if self.marks[other] == "flag" then
            flags = flags + 1
        end
    end
    return flags
end
function Game:unknown_neighbors(cell)
    local result = {}
    for _, other in ipairs(self.neighbors[cell]) do
        if self:unknown(other) then
            result[#result + 1] = other
        end
    end
    return result
end
function Game:copy(reset)
    local result = setmetatable({}, Game)
    for key, value in pairs(self) do
        result[key] = value
    end
    result.revealed, result.marks, result.moves =
        copy_list(self.revealed),
        copy_list(self.marks),
        copy_list(self.moves)
    result.undo = {}
    if reset then
        result:restart()
    end
    return result
end
function Game:set_placement(mines)
    local numbers = {}
    for cell, nearby in ipairs(self.neighbors) do
        local number = 0
        for _, other in ipairs(nearby) do
            if mines[other] then
                number = number + 1
            end
        end
        numbers[cell] = number
    end
    self.mines, self.numbers, self.state = mines, numbers, "playing"
end
function Game:place(first, safety)
    local sx, sy = (first - 1) % self.width, (first - 1) // self.width
    local candidates = {}
    for cell = 1, self.size do
        if
            safety == "none" or safety == "cell" and cell ~= first or
                safety == "block" and
                    (math.abs((cell - 1) % self.width - sx) >= 2 or
                        math.abs((cell - 1) // self.width - sy) >= 2)
         then
            candidates[#candidates + 1] = cell
        end
    end
    local mines, random = fill(self.size, false), self.seed
    for _ = 1, self.mine_count do
        random = 48271 * random % 2147483647
        local index = random % #candidates + 1
        mines[candidates[index]] = true
        table.remove(candidates, index)
    end
    self:set_placement(mines)
end
function Game:restart()
    self.revealed, self.marks = fill(self.size, false), fill(self.size, "none")
    self.moves, self.undo, self.exploded = {}, {}, nil
    self.state = self.mines and "playing" or "ready"
end
function Game:snapshot(name)
    return {
        name = name,
        revealed = copy_list(self.revealed),
        marks = copy_list(self.marks),
        move_count = #self.moves
    }
end
function Game:restore(saved)
    self.revealed, self.marks = saved.revealed, saved.marks
    while #self.moves > saved.move_count do
        self.moves[#self.moves] = nil
    end
end
function Game:record(kind, cell)
    self.moves[#self.moves + 1] = {kind = kind, cell = cell}
end
function Game:reveal(first, safety)
    if not self.mines then
        self:place(first, safety)
    end
    if self.mines[first] then
        self.state, self.exploded = "lost", first
        return 0
    end
    self.revealed[first], self.marks[first] = true, "none"
    local queue, head = {first}, 1
    while head <= #queue do
        local cell = queue[head]
        head = head + 1
        if self.numbers[cell] == 0 then
            for _, other in ipairs(self.neighbors[cell]) do
                if self:unknown(other) then
                    self.revealed[other], self.marks[other] = true, "none"
                    queue[#queue + 1] = other
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return #queue
end
function Game:chord(cell, safety)
    local opened = 0
    for _, other in ipairs(self.neighbors[cell]) do
        if self:unknown(other) then
            opened = opened + self:reveal(other, safety)
            if self.state == "lost" then
                break
            end
        end
    end
    return opened
end
function Game:check_win()
    if self.state ~= "playing" or self:open_count() ~= self.size - self.mine_count then
        return false
    end
    self.state = "won"
    for cell, mine in ipairs(self.mines) do
        if mine then
            self.marks[cell] = "flag"
        end
    end
    return true
end
function Game:display()
    for y = 0, self.height - 1 do
        local row = {}
        for x = 0, self.width - 1 do
            local cell = y * self.width + x + 1
            local character
            if self.state == "lost" and self.mines[cell] then
                character =
                    cell == self.exploded and "!" or (self.marks[cell] == "flag" and "F" or "*")
            elseif self.state == "lost" and self.marks[cell] == "flag" then
                character = "X"
            elseif self.revealed[cell] then
                character = self.numbers[cell] == 0 and "." or tostring(self.numbers[cell])
            else
                character =
                    self.marks[cell] == "flag" and "F" or
                    (self.marks[cell] == "question" and "?" or "#")
            end
            row[#row + 1] = character
        end
        emit(table.concat(row))
    end
end
function Game:ending()
    if self.state == "lost" then
        emit("boom", self:cell(self.exploded))
        self:display()
    elseif self.state == "won" then
        emit("win moves", #self.moves)
    end
end
function Game:constraints()
    local constraints = {}
    for cell = 1, self.size do
        if self.revealed[cell] and self.numbers[cell] > 0 then
            local unknown = self:unknown_neighbors(cell)
            if #unknown > 0 then
                local members = {}
                for _, other in ipairs(unknown) do
                    members[other] = true
                end
                constraints[#constraints + 1] = {
                    cell = cell,
                    unknown = unknown,
                    members = members,
                    remaining = self.numbers[cell] - self:flags(cell)
                }
            end
        end
    end
    return constraints
end
function Game:deduce()
    local result, constraints = {safe = {}, mines = {}}, self:constraints()
    for _, c in ipairs(constraints) do
        if c.remaining == 0 then
            for _, cell in ipairs(c.unknown) do
                result.safe[cell] = result.safe[cell] or "single " .. self:cell(c.cell)
            end
        end
    end
    if any_deduction(result) then
        return result
    end
    for _, c in ipairs(constraints) do
        if c.remaining == #c.unknown then
            for _, cell in ipairs(c.unknown) do
                result.mines[cell] = result.mines[cell] or "single " .. self:cell(c.cell)
            end
        end
    end
    if any_deduction(result) then
        return result
    end
    for _, a in ipairs(constraints) do
        for _, b in ipairs(constraints) do
            if #a.unknown < #b.unknown then
                local subset = true
                for _, cell in ipairs(a.unknown) do
                    if not b.members[cell] then
                        subset = false
                        break
                    end
                end
                if subset then
                    local difference = {}
                    for _, cell in ipairs(b.unknown) do
                        if not a.members[cell] then
                            difference[#difference + 1] = cell
                        end
                    end
                    local remaining = b.remaining - a.remaining
                    local reason = "subset " .. self:cell(a.cell) .. " " .. self:cell(b.cell)
                    if remaining == 0 then
                        for _, cell in ipairs(difference) do
                            result.safe[cell] = result.safe[cell] or reason
                        end
                    end
                    if remaining == #difference then
                        for _, cell in ipairs(difference) do
                            result.mines[cell] = result.mines[cell] or reason
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    if any_deduction(result) then
        return result
    end
    if self.state == "playing" and self:remaining() == 0 then
        for cell = 1, self.size do
            if self:unknown(cell) then
                result.safe[cell] = "count"
            end
        end
    end
    return result
end
function Game:frontier()
    local constraints, links = self:constraints(), {}
    for cell = 1, self.size do
        links[cell] = {}
    end
    for c, constraint in ipairs(constraints) do
        for _, cell in ipairs(constraint.unknown) do
            links[cell][#links[cell] + 1] = c
        end
    end
    local seen, components, at = {}, {}, {}
    for start = 1, self.size do
        if not seen[start] and #links[start] > 0 then
            local cells, selected, picked, head = {start}, {}, {}, 1
            seen[start] = true
            while head <= #cells do
                for _, c in ipairs(links[cells[head]]) do
                    if not picked[c] then
                        picked[c] = true
                        selected[#selected + 1] = constraints[c]
                        for _, cell in ipairs(constraints[c].unknown) do
                            if not seen[cell] then
                                seen[cell] = true
                                cells[#cells + 1] = cell
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                head = head + 1
            end
            table.sort(cells)
            local component = Component.new(cells, selected)
            components[#components + 1] = component
            for _, cell in ipairs(cells) do
                at[cell] = component
            end
        end
    end
    return {components = components, at = at}
end
function Game:auto(safety)
    local total = totals()
    while self.state == "playing" do
        local deduction = self:deduce()
        if not any_deduction(deduction) then
            break
        end
        total.rounds = total.rounds + 1
        for cell = 1, self.size do
            if deduction.safe[cell] and not self.revealed[cell] then
                self:record("auto-reveal", cell)
                total.opened = total.opened + self:reveal(cell, safety)
                self:check_win()
                if self:finished() then
                    return total
                end
            end
        end
        for cell = 1, self.size do
            if deduction.mines[cell] and self:unknown(cell) then
                self.marks[cell] = "flag"
                total.flagged = total.flagged + 1
                self:record("auto-flag", cell)
            end
        end
    end
    return total
end
function Game:solve(safety)
    local total = totals()
    while not self:finished() do
        add_totals(total, self:auto(safety))
        if self:finished() then
            break
        end
        local frontier = self:frontier()
        for _, component in ipairs(frontier.components) do
            component:count()
        end
        local unknown_count = 0
        for cell = 1, self.size do
            if self:unknown(cell) then
                unknown_count = unknown_count + 1
            end
        end
        local background = math.max(self:remaining(), 0)
        local best, best_numerator, best_denominator = nil, 0, 1
        for cell = 1, self.size do
            if self:unknown(cell) then
                local component = frontier.at[cell]
                local numerator, denominator
                if not component then
                    numerator, denominator = background, unknown_count
                elseif component.configurations > 0 then
                    numerator, denominator = component:mine_count(cell), component.configurations
                end
                if
                    numerator and
                        (not best or numerator * best_denominator < best_numerator * denominator)
                 then
                    best, best_numerator, best_denominator = cell, numerator, denominator
                end
            end
        end
        if not best then
            break
        end
        total.guesses = total.guesses + 1
        self:record("guess", best)
        total.opened = total.opened + self:reveal(best, safety)
        self:check_win()
    end
    return total
end
function Game:replay(count, safety)
    local copy = self:copy(true)
    for i = 1, count do
        local move = self.moves[i]
        local kind, cell = move.kind, move.cell
        if kind == "reveal" or kind == "auto-reveal" or kind == "guess" then
            copy:reveal(cell, safety)
        elseif kind == "chord" then
            copy:chord(cell, safety)
        elseif kind == "flag" or kind == "auto-flag" then
            copy.marks[cell] = "flag"
        elseif kind == "unflag" then
            copy.marks[cell] = "none"
        else
            copy.marks[cell] = copy.marks[cell] == "question" and "none" or "question"
        end
        copy:check_win()
    end
    return copy
end
function Game:board_info()
    local blank, seen = {}, {}
    for cell = 1, self.size do
        blank[cell] = not self.mines[cell] and self.numbers[cell] == 0
    end
    local openings, largest, isolated = 0, 0, 0
    for start = 1, self.size do
        if blank[start] and not seen[start] then
            openings = openings + 1
            local queue, head, area = {start}, 1, {[start] = true}
            seen[start] = true
            while head <= #queue do
                for _, cell in ipairs(self.neighbors[queue[head]]) do
                    area[cell] = true
                    if blank[cell] and not seen[cell] then
                        seen[cell] = true
                        queue[#queue + 1] = cell
                    end
                end
                head = head + 1
            end
            largest = math.max(largest, count_true(area))
        end
        if not self.mines[start] and not blank[start] then
            local adjacent_blank = false
            for _, cell in ipairs(self.neighbors[start]) do
                if blank[cell] then
                    adjacent_blank = true
                    break
                end
            end
            if not adjacent_blank then
                isolated = isolated + 1
            end
        end
    end
    emit(
        "3bv",
        openings + isolated,
        "openings",
        openings,
        "largest",
        largest,
        "mines",
        self.mine_count,
        "safe",
        self.size - self.mine_count
    )
end

local ARITY = {
    NEW = 4,
    PRESET = 2,
    SAFETY = 1,
    RESTART = 0,
    REVEAL = 2,
    FLAG = 2,
    UNFLAG = 2,
    QUESTION = 2,
    CHORD = 2,
    UNDO = 0,
    SHOW = 0,
    STATUS = 0,
    CELL = 2,
    HISTORY = 1,
    REPLAY = 1,
    HINT = 0,
    AUTO = 0,
    ANALYZE = 0,
    PROB = 2,
    FRONTIER = 0,
    SOLVE = 0,
    BOARDINFO = 0,
    STATS = 0
}
local CELL_COMMANDS = {
    REVEAL = true,
    FLAG = true,
    UNFLAG = true,
    QUESTION = true,
    CHORD = true,
    CELL = true,
    PROB = true
}
local ACTIVE_COMMANDS = {
    REVEAL = true,
    FLAG = true,
    UNFLAG = true,
    QUESTION = true,
    CHORD = true,
    UNDO = true,
    HINT = true,
    AUTO = true,
    ANALYZE = true,
    PROB = true,
    FRONTIER = true,
    SOLVE = true
}
local UNDOABLE = {
    REVEAL = true,
    FLAG = true,
    UNFLAG = true,
    QUESTION = true,
    CHORD = true,
    AUTO = true,
    SOLVE = true
}
local PRESETS = {beginner = {9, 9, 10}, intermediate = {16, 16, 40}, expert = {30, 16, 99}}
local SAFETY = {block = true, cell = true, none = true}
local function number_word(word)
    if #word > 10 or not word:match("^%d+$") or #word > 1 and word:sub(1, 1) == "0" then
        fail("bad arguments")
    end
    return tonumber(word)
end

local Program = {}
Program.__index = Program
function Program.new()
    return setmetatable(
        {safety = "block", played = 0, won = 0, lost = 0, streak = 0, best_streak = 0},
        Program
    )
end
function Program:layout(words)
    local width, height, rows = tonumber(words[2]), tonumber(words[3]), {}
    for i = 1, height do
        rows[i] = input_line()
    end
    local mines, count = {}, 0
    for i, row in ipairs(rows) do
        if #row ~= width or row:find("[^*.]") then
            fail("bad row " .. i)
        end
        for x = 1, width do
            local mine = row:sub(x, x) == "*"
            mines[#mines + 1] = mine
            if mine then
                count = count + 1
            end
        end
    end
    if count == 0 or count == width * height then
        fail("bad mine count " .. count)
    end
    self.game = Game.new(width, height, count, 1, mines)
    emit("layout", width .. "x" .. height, "mines", count)
end
function Program:stats()
    local rate = self.played == 0 and "-" or (self.won * 100 // self.played) .. "%"
    emit(
        "stats played",
        self.played,
        "won",
        self.won,
        "lost",
        self.lost,
        "rate",
        rate,
        "streak",
        self.streak,
        "best",
        self.best_streak,
        "fastest",
        self.fastest or "-"
    )
end
function Program:record_finish(game)
    self.played = self.played + 1
    if game.state == "won" then
        self.won, self.streak = self.won + 1, self.streak + 1
        self.best_streak = math.max(self.best_streak, self.streak)
        self.fastest = math.min(self.fastest or #game.moves, #game.moves)
    else
        self.lost, self.streak = self.lost + 1, 0
    end
end
function Program:execute(words)
    local op = words[1]
    if op == "LAYOUT" then
        self:layout(words)
        return
    end
    if ARITY[op] == nil then
        fail("unknown command " .. op)
    end
    if #words ~= ARITY[op] + 1 then
        fail("bad arguments")
    end
    local values = {}
    if op == "NEW" or CELL_COMMANDS[op] or op == "HISTORY" or op == "REPLAY" then
        for i = 2, #words do
            values[#values + 1] = number_word(words[i])
        end
    elseif op == "PRESET" then
        if not PRESETS[words[2]] then
            fail("bad arguments")
        end
        values[1] = number_word(words[3])
    elseif op == "SAFETY" and not SAFETY[words[2]] then
        fail("bad arguments")
    end

    if op == "NEW" or op == "PRESET" then
        local width, height, mines, seed
        if op == "NEW" then
            width, height, mines, seed = table.unpack(values)
        else
            width, height, mines = table.unpack(PRESETS[words[2]])
            seed = values[1]
        end
        if
            width < 1 or width > 30 or height < 1 or height > 30 or mines < 1 or
                mines > width * height - 9 or
                seed < 1 or
                seed > 2147483646
         then
            fail("bad value")
        end
        self.game = Game.new(width, height, mines, seed)
        emit("new", width .. "x" .. height, "mines", mines)
        return
    end
    if op == "HISTORY" and values[1] == 0 then
        fail("bad value")
    end
    if op == "SAFETY" then
        self.safety = words[2]
        emit("safety", self.safety)
        return
    end
    if op == "STATS" then
        self:stats()
        return
    end
    local game = self.game
    if not game then
        fail("no game")
    end
    if CELL_COMMANDS[op] and (values[1] >= game.width or values[2] >= game.height) then
        fail("out of range")
    end
    local cell = CELL_COMMANDS[op] and (values[2] * game.width + values[1] + 1) or 1
    if game:finished() and ACTIVE_COMMANDS[op] then
        fail("game over")
    end
    if (op == "ANALYZE" or op == "BOARDINFO") and not game.mines then
        fail("not started")
    end
    local was_finished = game:finished()
    local saved = UNDOABLE[op] and game:snapshot(op:lower()) or nil

    if op == "RESTART" then
        game:restart()
        emit("restart", game.width .. "x" .. game.height, "mines", game.mine_count)
    elseif op == "REVEAL" then
        if game.revealed[cell] then
            fail("already revealed")
        end
        if game.marks[cell] == "flag" then
            fail("flagged")
        end
        game:record("reveal", cell)
        local opened = game:reveal(cell, self.safety)
        if game.state ~= "lost" then
            emit("revealed", opened)
            game:check_win()
        end
        game:ending()
    elseif op == "FLAG" or op == "UNFLAG" or op == "QUESTION" then
        if game.revealed[cell] then
            fail("already revealed")
        end
        if op == "FLAG" and game.marks[cell] == "flag" then
            fail("already flagged")
        end
        if op == "UNFLAG" and game.marks[cell] ~= "flag" then
            fail("not flagged")
        end
        local mark, verb
        if op == "FLAG" then
            mark, verb = "flag", "flagged"
        elseif op == "UNFLAG" then
            mark, verb = "none", "unflagged"
        else
            mark = game.marks[cell] == "question" and "none" or "question"
            verb = mark == "none" and "unmarked" or "questioned"
        end
        game.marks[cell] = mark
        game:record(op:lower(), cell)
        emit(verb, game:cell(cell), "left", game:remaining())
    elseif op == "CHORD" then
        if not game.revealed[cell] then
            fail("not revealed")
        end
        if game.numbers[cell] == 0 then
            fail("no number")
        end
        local flags = game:flags(cell)
        if flags ~= game.numbers[cell] then
            fail("flags " .. flags .. " of " .. game.numbers[cell])
        end
        if #game:unknown_neighbors(cell) == 0 then
            fail("nothing to reveal")
        end
        game:record("chord", cell)
        local opened = game:chord(cell, self.safety)
        if game.state ~= "lost" then
            emit("chorded", opened)
            game:check_win()
        end
        game:ending()
    elseif op == "UNDO" then
        if #game.undo == 0 then
            fail("nothing to undo")
        end
        local record = table.remove(game.undo)
        game:restore(record)
        emit("undo", record.name, "moves", #game.moves)
    elseif op == "SHOW" then
        game:display()
    elseif op == "STATUS" then
        emit(
            "status",
            game.state,
            "left",
            game:remaining(),
            "moves",
            #game.moves,
            "revealed",
            game:open_count() .. "/" .. (game.size - game.mine_count)
        )
    elseif op == "CELL" then
        if game.revealed[cell] then
            emit(
                "cell",
                game:cell(cell),
                "number",
                game.numbers[cell],
                "flags",
                game:flags(cell),
                "unknown",
                #game:unknown_neighbors(cell)
            )
        else
            local opened = 0
            for _, other in ipairs(game.neighbors[cell]) do
                if game.revealed[other] then
                    opened = opened + 1
                end
            end
            emit("cell", game:cell(cell), "hidden mark", game.marks[cell], "open", opened)
        end
    elseif op == "HISTORY" then
        emit("history", #game.moves)
        for i = math.max(1, #game.moves - values[1] + 1), #game.moves do
            local move = game.moves[i]
            emit(i, move.kind, game:cell(move.cell))
        end
    elseif op == "REPLAY" then
        if values[1] > #game.moves then
            fail("no move " .. values[1])
        end
        emit("replay", values[1] .. "/" .. #game.moves)
        game:replay(values[1], self.safety):display()
    elseif op == "HINT" then
        local deduction, found = game:deduce(), false
        for _, kind in ipairs({"safe", "mine"}) do
            local reasons = kind == "safe" and deduction.safe or deduction.mines
            for at = 1, game.size do
                if reasons[at] then
                    emit("hint", kind, game:cell(at), "by", reasons[at])
                    found = true
                    break
                end
            end
            if found then
                break
            end
        end
        if not found then
            emit("hint none")
        end
    elseif op == "AUTO" or op == "SOLVE" then
        local total = op == "AUTO" and game:auto(self.safety) or game:solve(self.safety)
        if op == "AUTO" then
            emit("auto rounds", total.rounds, "flagged", total.flagged, "revealed", total.opened)
        else
            emit(
                "solve guesses",
                total.guesses,
                "rounds",
                total.rounds,
                "flagged",
                total.flagged,
                "revealed",
                total.opened
            )
        end
        game:ending()
    elseif op == "ANALYZE" then
        local copy = game:copy()
        local total = copy:auto(self.safety)
        if copy.state == "lost" then
            emit("analyze boom", copy:cell(copy.exploded), "rounds", total.rounds)
        elseif copy.state == "won" then
            emit("analyze clear rounds", total.rounds)
        else
            emit(
                "analyze stuck rounds",
                total.rounds,
                "revealed",
                copy:open_count() .. "/" .. (copy.size - copy.mine_count)
            )
        end
    elseif op == "PROB" then
        if game.revealed[cell] then
            fail("already revealed")
        end
        if game.marks[cell] == "flag" then
            fail("flagged")
        end
        local component = game:frontier().at[cell]
        if not component then
            emit("prob", game:cell(cell), "unconstrained")
        else
            component:count()
            if component.configurations == 0 then
                emit("prob", game:cell(cell), "inconsistent")
            else
                emit(
                    "prob",
                    game:cell(cell),
                    fraction(component:mine_count(cell), component.configurations),
                    "size",
                    #component.cells,
                    "configs",
                    component.configurations
                )
            end
        end
    elseif op == "FRONTIER" then
        local frontier = game:frontier()
        emit("frontier", count_true(frontier.at), "components", #frontier.components)
        for _, component in ipairs(frontier.components) do
            component:count()
            if component.configurations == 0 then
                emit(
                    "component",
                    game:cell(component.cells[1]),
                    "size",
                    #component.cells,
                    "inconsistent"
                )
            else
                emit(
                    "component",
                    game:cell(component.cells[1]),
                    "size",
                    #component.cells,
                    "configs",
                    component.configurations,
                    "min",
                    component.minimum,
                    "max",
                    component.maximum
                )
            end
        end
    elseif op == "BOARDINFO" then
        game:board_info()
    end
    if saved and #game.moves > saved.move_count then
        game.undo[#game.undo + 1] = saved
    end
    if not was_finished and game:finished() then
        self:record_finish(game)
    end
end

local program = Program.new()
local command_count = tonumber(input_line())
for _ = 1, command_count do
    local ok, problem = pcall(program.execute, program, split(input_line()))
    if not ok then
        if type(problem) == "table" and problem.command_error then
            emit("error:", problem.message)
        else
            error(problem, 0)
        end
    end
end
